geography.notes: Energy Trust renewable-electric incentives are tied to Oregon PGE and Pacific Power delivery or offset in official OPUC materials.

hardRequirements: Project must be a renewable electricity generation project, not a building heat-pump retrofit.

Current official evidence supports solar and storage portfolio activity and custom hydro or biopower, with older official scope also listing geothermal electric and limited municipal community-scale wind.
Generation must deliver power to or offset Portland General Electric or Pacific Power load in Oregon.
blockers: The current Energy Trust renewable-energy page and forms could not be accessed because energytrust.org search access was blocked by robots.txt.
Current application forms, incentive calculations, and deadline or rolling terms were not directly readable.
No current official evidence supports geothermal heat pumps under this custom renewable generation opportunity.

repairs.reasoningNotes: Medium confidence is assigned because accessible official OPUC evidence verifies active renewable generation support and broad technologies, but the current Energy Trust application page was inaccessible.
